vsm2.13:43.2: 14. “At the place where the Yāma Deities are established. The places where the Cātumahārājika and Tāvatiṃsa heavens become established do not reappear at first because they are connected with the earth” (Vism-mhṭ 412).
vsm2.13:57.1: 15. Khārudaka—“caustic waters”: the name given to the waters on which the world-spheres rest (see M-a IV 178).
vsm2.13:60.3: 16. Kūṭāgāra: see Ch. XII, n.14; here this seems the most likely of the various meanings of the word.
